description:
Fair Deal Property, Your Trusted Experts for Residential Property Sales, 

Are delighted to present to you for sale Number 17 Dún Chaoin, a spacious and beautifully maintained four-bedroom residence located on Castle Road in the heart of Dunmore Town.

Ideally situated just 10 minutes from Tuam Town and only a 40-minute commute to Galway City, Dún Chaoin is a boutique residential development comprising a small number of exceptionally well-kept homes, all within walking distance of the excellent amenities that Dunmore has to offer.

Number 17 enjoys a prime position at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac, providing an added sense of privacy and security with no passing traffic, making it an ideal setting for families with young children.

On arrival, you are greeted by a spacious driveway with ample parking for multiple vehicles. The home immediately impresses with its bright and welcoming entrance hallway, where the stairwell is thoughtfully positioned back from the main entrance, creating a wonderful sense of openness and natural light.

The living room is beautifully proportioned and flooded with daylight, featuring natural wood flooring along with a charming feature fireplace which creates a warm and inviting atmosphere.

This leads through to the spacious open-plan kitchen and dining area, which offers exceptional floor space along with ample built-in storage, a breakfast bar, and an abundance of natural light from the glazed patio doors. These overlook the fully enclosed and beautifully planted rear garden along with the open pasturelands beyond, providing a peaceful and scenic backdrop.

Adjacent to the kitchen is an ideal-sized utility room along with a large guest WC, adding further practicality to this superb family home.

Upstairs, the accommodation continues to impress with four bright and well-presented bedrooms, all featuring natural pitch pine wood flooring along with built-in storage. The master bedroom comes complete with its own en suite, while a well-maintained family bathroom completes the accommodation.

If you are searching for a spacious four-bedroom residence in a highly convenient location that represents outstanding value for money, then we suggest you look no further than Number 17 Dún Chaoin, as it is certain to meet all of your requirements.

Call Fair Deal Property today to register your interest. We would be delighted to hear from you and to show you around.
